2609.04071.title: TAP-Path: Task-Adaptive Structural and Token Pruning for Efficient and Trustworthy Pathology Foundation Models
2609.04071.paper_summary: Pathology foundation models improve transferable representation learning for histopathology, but recent gains often rely on encoders with hundreds of millions of parameters and high inference cost. We propose TAP-Path, a task-adaptive compression framework that directly restructures a pretrained Virchow2 encoder rather than distilling it into a separate student. TAP-Path combines validation-driven transformer-block selection, physical removal of redundant blocks, input-adaptive patch-token pruning, multi-depth feature recovery, and a lightweight gated task head. The final model retains 24 of 32 transformer blocks and 70% of patch tokens after pruning, reducing encoder parameters by 24.96% (631.24M to 473.70M) and analytical encoder compute by 35.20% (340.13G to 220.40G FLOPs). Across three task-head optimization seeds, TAP-Path achieved $87.98 \pm 0.067%$ test accuracy, $81.26 \pm 0.49%$ balanced accuracy, and $82.38 \pm 0.48%$ macro-F1 on a 32-class histopathology benchmark, compared with 86.89% for full Virchow2 and 87.67% for UNI2-h. TAP-Path achieved a Brier score of $0.1800 \pm 0.0005$ and failure-detection AUROC of $0.9047 \pm 0.0060$. A validation-only rare-aware objective improved rare-class balanced accuracy in a secondary operating analysis. Frozen external evaluation on 433 CPTAC samples yielded $91.22 \pm 0.83%$ accuracy and $91.10 \pm 0.81%$ balanced accuracy. These results show that task-adaptive structural and token sparsification can improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of large pathology foundation models while preserving reliability under internal and external evaluation.
2609.04071.paper_summary_zh: 病理基礎模型改善了組織病理學的可轉移表示學習，但最近的進展通常依賴於擁有數億參數和高推理成本的編碼器。我們提出了 TAP-Path，一個任務自適應壓縮框架，直接重組預訓練的 Virchow2 編碼器，而不是將其蒸餾成一個單獨的學生。TAP-Path 結合了基於驗證的Transformer塊選擇、冗餘塊的物理移除、輸入自適應的補丁標記修剪、多深度特徵恢復和輕量級的門控任務頭。最終模型在修剪後保留了 32 個Transformer塊中的 24 個和 70% 的補丁標記，將編碼器參數減少了 24.96%（從 631.24M 減少到 473.70M），分析編碼器計算減少了 35.20%（從 340.13G 減少到 220.40G FLOPs）。在三個任務頭優化種子中，TAP-Path 在 32 類組織病理學基準上達到了 $87.98 \pm 0.067%$ 的測試準確率、$81.26 \pm 0.49%$ 的平衡準確率和 $82.38 \pm 0.48%$ 的宏 F1，相較於完整的 Virchow2 的 86.89% 和 UNI2-h 的 87.67%。TAP-Path 的 Brier 分數為 $0.1800 \pm 0.0005$，失敗檢測的 AUROC 為 $0.9047 \pm 0.0060$。僅驗證的稀有感知目標在次要操作分析中提高了稀有類別的平衡準確率。在 433 個 CPTAC 樣本上的凍結外部評估產生了 $91.22 \pm 0.83%$ 的準確率和 $91.10 \pm 0.81%$ 的平衡準確率。這些結果表明，任務自適應的結構和標記稀疏化可以在保持內部和外部評估的可靠性的同時改善大型病理基礎模型的準確性與效率的權衡。
